aesl22_nrf.notes: One nRF52811/S112 application and OTA artifact covers the Alibaba Cloud AESL family. The bounded 0.2.0 core uses frozen protocol 0x20 for identity, time, screen profile, direct transfer, persistent label/settings, native pages, typed image records/slideshow, health telemetry, reset and Buttonless DFU. It retains the complete common UC/JD/SSD controller/profile catalog, including both 152x152 and 200x200 1.54-inch geometries. The target does not compile or advertise activation, Find, NFC or custom layouts; it also leaves the fixed BLE name, unqualified input/buzzer, health thresholds and scoped lifecycle actions unadvertised. Image records use the owner-released 472 KiB range after the settings and font/reserve regions in FM25Q04; the original complete 512 KiB image remains backed up off-device, and allocation erases only sectors selected for a new record. The permanently Free target exposes the common quota of five compact or two normal/large records. Direct transfer retains the default 20-byte ATT payload and Recovery derives InkTag_NRF_<ID4>_OTA from the same factory identity as the application. EL022H2 external-Flash identification/backup, bounded write/erase, font provisioning/readback, runtime Journal creation/compaction, time/profile reset persistence, Hema 2.13 BWR native/direct/record output, record/slideshow, active-write reset recovery and signed OTA retransmission passed on hardware. Hard power-loss interruption, optical branding, current and long-soak regression remain open. EL029H2 is a user-identified replaceable-panel variant whose shared PCB, external-Flash identity/wiring and display profile still require exact-board regression.

The 0.2.0 application uses frozen protocol 0x20 without legacy commands and advertises the qualified P0.02 input, exact-board-qualified offline activation and default-off Pro-only EXPERIMENTAL_FIND. Activation rejection/install, soft-reset and two-OTA persistence plus guarded test cleanup pass; production exposes no cleanup/Debug path. The health/crash backend remains unadvertised; its raw policy follows the common 2400/2000/0/2400/2600 mV warning/critical/display/Flash/OTA thresholds and invalid-ADC fail-safe. Fresh fail-closed Flash/OTA checks now guard every actual erase/write submission, while thresholdsQualified stays false pending exact-board load/sag evidence. It retains all registered public EPD drivers/recipes, shared native pages, direct transfer, profile management, OTA/Recovery and the bounded 68 KiB image store; activation and Find are omitted. SmartSnippets Toolbox 5.0.10.2434 with a 3.3 V CH340 completed only the former-layout full first flash and cold-boot BLE advertising; J-Flash attach was unreliable before first flash, and DAPLink virtual COM did not complete SPI Flash operations. Select and persist the qualified 2.9-inch profile before any display operation; the repacked layout, image records, voltage, V2 and SUOTA regression remain pending.
